# Inference & Serving

High-throughput production model serving on GPUs.

*4 projects · catalog last checked 2026-10-20. "Highlight" is editorial; status, commit and release come from the [weekly evidence refresh](../freshness.md).*

## Comparison

| Project | What it does | Highlight (editorial) | Deployment | Hardware | Licence | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [vLLM](#vllm) | PagedAttention-based high-throughput server | Throughput | self-hosted | gpu-required | Apache-2.0 | active |
| [SGLang](#sglang) | Fast serving with structured generation | Structured outputs | self-hosted | gpu-required | Apache-2.0 | active |
| [Text Generation Inference](#text-generation-inference) | Production LLM server | HF Hub integration | self-hosted | gpu-required | Apache-2.0 | ⚠ **archived upstream** |
| [Triton Inference Server](#triton-server) | Multi-framework model server | Mixed model fleets | self-hosted | gpu-required | BSD-3-Clause | active |

## Quick start

```bash
pip install vllm
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct --port 8000
```
Needs an NVIDIA GPU (8 GB+ VRAM for small models).
